resumption_policy: ONE_SHOT transferable with pre-imposed expectations: this window is the single registered resumption attempt after route-probe success.

stop_policies.route_failure: any contiguous provider-failure run or provider_success < 1.0 at window end renders the window FAIL; lane stays STOPPED permanently; no further windows
stop_policies.bridge_hang: uncaught subprocess TimeoutExpired (eligibility_runner.py:403) -> window FAIL with BRIDGE_HANG class; lane stays STOPPED permanently
stop_policies.timeout: run killed at tool envelope -> window FAIL (no persistence guarantee); lane stays STOPPED permanently

terminal_consequence: if this window fails: replication lane remains STOPPED; final report proceeds PRIMARY-ONLY with registered missing-replication note; no further registered retries
notes: If window-6 PASSES with provider_success 1.0, replicate results get frozen (Freeze 3) and the statistics report is regenerated with tags and interpretation rule 1.
